subject: Film & Cinema
title: Chinese Cinema: Fifth Generation and Beyond
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Chinese Cinema: Fifth Generation and Beyond.

hook.text: China's Fifth Generation filmmakers turned cameras on their own country and the world took notice.

buildup.text: Zhang Yimou and Chen Kaige made visually stunning films that explored Chinese history and identity.

discovery.text: Raise the Red Lantern and Farewell My Concubine became international art-house sensations.

twist.text: Chinese censorship limits what filmmakers can show — many push boundaries and face consequences.

climax.text: China's domestic box office is now rivaling Hollywood's, reshaping global cinema economics.

punchline.text: The world's oldest culture is building its newest cinema.

quiz.question: Who are key directors of China's Fifth Generation?
